title: Cascade Floor-Standing Headboard Divan Bed
descriptionHtml:
A headboard that runs from high on the wall all the way to the floor. The Cascade Divan Bed pairs a tall, floor-standing padded headboard with a fully upholstered divan base, for a clean, built-in look.

Key features

  • Tall floor-standing headboard in vertical padded panels
  • Fully upholstered divan base with optional storage drawers
  • No exposed legs, with a neat finish to the floor
  • Handmade to order in our West Yorkshire workshop

Materials and build

Built on a solid wood frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to mainland UK addresses by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
